edges.subject: KCTD7
edges.quote: Biallelic variants in KCTD7 cause a rare autosomal recessive PME (MIM #611726).

edges.subject: KCTD7-related PME
edges.quote: Initial symptoms were seizures (four patients) or developmental delay (two patients), with regression in five patients.
